h1: The 5 Best Monitor Privacy Screens Under $100 of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Monitor Privacy Screens: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five monitor privacy screens, all under $50, for 24 and 27 inch displays, compared on viewing angle, coating and pack size.
summary: The Vxaop 27 inch 2-pack leads with a listed 60 degree viewing angle, anti-glare coating and blue-light reduction. The Protescreen 27 inch 2-pack is a close second, the Syhauifei and Magicmoon 24 inch 2-packs suit two-monitor desks, and the SightPro is the single-sheet 24 inch option.
intro: A privacy filter only works if it matches your monitor's exact visible dimensions, and many buyers order by the diagonal size and discover the film is a few millimeters off. Measuring first saves a return.

We reviewed eight filters on paper, comparing sizes, viewing angle, coatings and pack counts from the listing data, and ranked the five that were clearly monitor-sized. Everything here falls in the $25-50 bucket, well under $100.

products.name: Vxaop [2-Pack] 27 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter (16:9 Aspect Ratio)
products.verdict: A 2-pack with a 60 degree viewing limit and anti-glare coating.
products.description:
This Vxaop set gives you two 27 inch filters for 16:9 monitors. The listing states 60 degree privacy protection, an anti-glare matte coating and 95 percent blue light reduction.

It ranks first because it publishes concrete numbers for all three features, which the rival listings do not. The tradeoff against the Protescreen is that a 60 degree limit is a stated figure, while the other offers less detail.

It suits a 27 inch desk where glare is also a problem. The caveat is that it only fits 16:9 monitors of that size.
products.idealFor: 27 inch desks needing privacy and glare control.

products.name: [2 Pack] Computer Privacy Screen 27 Inch for 16:9 Widescreen Monitor
products.verdict: Two 27 inch filters from a brand that updated its design.
products.description:
The Protescreen set includes two 27 inch privacy filters for 16:9 widescreen monitors. The listing says the filter has gone through 200 updates.

It ranks second because its feature list is thinner than the Vxaop, with no stated viewing angle. The 2-pack format still gives you a spare or a second monitor covered.

It suits buyers with two 27 inch monitors. The caveat is that you should confirm the viewing angle before relying on it.
products.skipIf: You want a published viewing angle.

products.name: [2-Pack] 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen 16:9 Aspect Ratio Widescreen Monitor
products.verdict: A 24 inch 2-pack with dimensions listed and mounting included.
products.description:
This 24 inch set lists exact dimensions of 20 15/16 by 11 13/16 inches (532 by 299 mm). It uses a micro-louver design and comes with two simple mounting methods.

It ranks third because the listed dimensions let you measure before you buy, unlike the Magicmoon, though it publishes no viewing angle. Two mounting options help if you remove the filter often.

It suits a pair of 24 inch monitors. The caveat is that you must check your visible area against 532 by 299 mm.
products.idealFor: Two 24 inch monitors with a measured fit.
products.skipIf: You do not want to measure first.

products.name: Magicmoon 2-Pack 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 16:9 Monitor
products.verdict: A 24 inch 2-pack aimed at open workspaces.
products.description:
The Magicmoon set gives you two filters for 24 inch (diagonally measured) 16:9 monitors. Its listing says the screen appears dark from the side and promotes privacy in open work spaces.

It ranks fourth because the listing gives fewer concrete numbers than the Syhauifei set. The side darkening is the key behavior for coworkers sitting nearby.

It suits shared offices and hot desks. The caveat is that it fits only 24 inch screens.
products.skipIf: You need exact dimensions up front.

products.name: SightPro 24 Inch 16:9 Computer Privacy Screen Filter for Monitor
products.verdict: A single 24 inch multi-layer filter for one monitor.
products.description:
The SightPro is a single 24 inch 16:9 filter with a multi-layered film. The listed visible area is 20 15/16 by 11 13/16 inches (532 by 299 mm).

It ranks last because you get one filter, not two, so a dual-monitor desk costs more overall. The listed dimensions make it easy to check fit.

It suits a single 24 inch monitor. The caveat is that it offers no pack savings.

whatMatters.detail: Privacy filters are cut to the visible screen area, not the diagonal alone. A few millimeters off leaves a gap or covers the bezel. Measure your visible area and compare it to the listing, such as 532 by 299 mm for a 24 inch.
The viewing angle is how far from center the screen stays readable. A narrower angle like 60 degrees blocks more side views. Look for a stated figure.
Most listings are for 16:9 monitors. An ultrawide or 16:10 panel will not fit. Check your monitor's ratio first.
Anti-glare and blue light features add comfort. They matter if you work long hours. Look for matte coating or blue light percentage.
Some filters use adhesive strips, others tabs. Removable options help if you share the screen. Check the mounting description.

faq.q: Will a 24 inch filter fit any 24 inch monitor?
faq.a: Only if the visible area matches. The Syhauifei and SightPro list 532 by 299 mm, so measure first.
No, these are for 16:9 monitors. Ultrawide panels need a different cut.

faq.q: Is the Vxaop worth it over the Protescreen?
faq.a: It lists a 60 degree angle, anti-glare and blue light numbers, while the Protescreen does not. Both are 27 inch 2-packs.

faq.q: How do I install a filter?
faq.a: Clean the screen and attach using the included mounting method. The Syhauifei lists two methods.
Privacy films usually darken the picture somewhat. Raise brightness if needed.
Removable mounts allow this. Check the mounting description before buying.

finalTake: For most 27 inch desks the Vxaop 2-pack is the best buy thanks to a stated 60 degree angle and anti-glare coating. The Protescreen is a close alternative, the Syhauifei and Magicmoon fit 24 inch pairs, and the SightPro is the one-screen choice.
